The '''Aquilaris Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquilaris Minor]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the Aquilaris Minor system was invented to account for mapping discrepancies between [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] and previous sources.<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=The new "Minor" worlds were invented to account for mapping discrepancies between the Atlas and Knight Errant.}}</ref>
